item.description:
## 1.0.18
- Added a built-in local NHI MCP server and native helper for Claude Desktop. The helper keeps MAP and Google credentials in Email Reminder and exposes a documented delegation skill and typed NHI tools. - Added one-click Claude Desktop MCP connection setup, with no per-user skill script or manually copied bridge token. - Added exact schema guidance for creating NHI delegations, including access groups, resolved assignees, expected results, and artifacts. - Added built-in Codex Desktop, Claude Desktop, VS Code, and CLI agent profiles, plus a default NHI access-group setting. - Added an optional floating NHI debug console for local Bridge, synchronization, and agent-launch diagnostics. - Claude Desktop handoffs now open a new Code chat, type the task briefing directly, and submit it without using the clipboard when Accessibility permission is granted.

## 1.0.17
- Let a coordination task open an agent picker on click, including retry after a failed agent launch. - Kept IDE handoff tasks actionable after the briefing is opened so they can be sent again or routed to another agent.

## 1.0.16
- Fixed a Settings crash when SwiftUI refreshed an Agent Profile binding after that profile had been removed.
